source: SkiWelt Wilder Kaiser - Brixental interactive piste map (winter.intermaps.com/skiwelt, the map on skiwelt.at), minus the runs that also appear on the KitzSki map (winter.intermaps.com/kitzski): that map shows the neighbouring KitzSki area too, which is a separate resort; matched by run name with the piste number removed (a name shared by several numbered runs takes the hardest of their colours), not by number alone, because run numbers repeat between areas
numbers_note: numbers used by one SkiWelt run only; a number shared by two runs (11, 40, 60, 66, 73, 84, ...) is matched by name only
same_as_note: The resort lists these under a combined number or a slightly different name; the map run named on the right is the same run.
